Why Merino 

100% Ultra-Fine Merino

Nature’s finest performance fiber. Upgraded.

Merino wool is breathable, thermoregulating, odor-resistant, and incredibly soft, nature’s own high-performance material.

Unlike synthetics, it stays fresh and adapts to your body. Unlike cotton, it insulates even when wet and dries fast. Unlike traditional wool, it’s itch-free, lightweight, and wearable all year.

At Merso®️, we take pure merino and give it an edge:

  • Machine-washable: thanks to advanced treatments.
  • Structured fit:  engineered through precision knitting.
  • Lasting comfort:  spun to resist pilling and retain shape.
  • Unlimited colors:  curated tones with rich, wearable depth.

100% merino. Pure performance. For Everyday Adventures

settings.title: How to wash
settings.content:
• Machine wash temperature (30°C / 85°F)
  • Use a gentle cycle
  • Mild detergent only
  • Turn garments inside out
  • Wash with like colors

settings.title: How to Dry
settings.content:
• Lay flat to dry
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not wring or twist
  • Never hang wet, it can stretch the fibers

settings.title: How to Store
settings.content:
• Fold, don’t hang, to preserve the shape
  • Keep in a dry, cool place
  • Optional: use cedar or lavender to naturally deter moths

settings.title: Pro Tip
settings.subheading: Care less. Wear more. That’s the Merso way.
settings.content: Merino stays fresh for longer. Air it out between wears to reduce washing and extend its life.
